attribution: Derived from eBird.org, Cornell Lab of Ornithology, and its contributors.
coverage: Only the latest accepted report per species at each exact hotspot within the previous 30 days. Notable means the species also occurs in the separate provincial eBird notable feed after exact hotspot filtering in that window.
warnings: Reporting effort differs. Missing means not returned in this source window, not absent. These are not seasonal or historical species totals.

A notable label is an eBird feed flag from a provincial feed filtered to this exact hotspot, not a local rarity assessment. Provincial feed coverage can omit other notable reports. It can refer to a different checklist for the same species in the window.
Observation times are the source’s local checklist time; collection times are UTC. Sensitive or restricted records may be excluded by eBird.
